nodes.label: Mutual Friend Graph (request + accept)
nodes.rationale: Requester sends, addressee accepts; 'my friends' are accepted rows where auth.uid() is on either side. Mutual consent chosen so nobody can unilaterally attach themselves to another user.

nodes.label: Friendship as Discovery Layer Only
nodes.rationale: Friendship grants zero list or errand access — a friend tap just calls the existing onInvite(email)/onAddShopper(email) flows. This keeps risk low and requires no changes to existing grocery RLS or membership logic. Consequence: unfriending does not revoke already-granted memberships.

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER RPCs over Raw Client Queries
nodes.rationale: Three reasons: keep other users' emails private by preventing direct auth.users reads, dedupe a request across both directions atomically, and resolve user_id to email server-side to avoid N+1 lookups.

nodes.label: friendships RLS Policy Matrix
nodes.rationale: SELECT and DELETE allow either party; INSERT requires requester_id = auth.uid(); UPDATE is restricted to addressee_id = auth.uid() so a requester can never self-accept their own request.

nodes.label: FriendType (other-party-relative shape)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately stores the OTHER person's userId and email plus a direction marker, so the UI never has to branch on whether the current user was requester or addressee.

nodes.label: Standalone @himan/shared/friends Module Decision
nodes.rationale: The friend graph is not grocery-specific, so it gets its own module for a clean boundary and reuse by web and future features; the shared layer stays UI-agnostic so web can adopt it later without rework.

nodes.label: ShareListModal (list invitation flow)
nodes.rationale: Existing flow: email -> grocery_invitations row -> invitee accepts -> grocery_list_members. Friend picker sits above the email field and reuses the same onInvite(email) path.

nodes.label: AddShopperModal (session membership flow)
nodes.rationale: Existing flow: email -> get_user_id_by_email RPC -> direct grocery_session_members insert. Unlike lists, there is no acceptance step for shoppers.
